# One complete SHELL_TONE block as the board printed it, header to end
# marker: lines 898-1852 of
# .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-18-coupon-codec-tone-probe/task-5-board-capture.txt
# (2026-09-19). Vendored here because that workspace is gitignored, and a
# guard whose input is missing everywhere but one machine is not a guard.
#
# IMAGE. The firmware stamps its own build on SHELL_TONE_CFG: git=86070d9+.
# The trailing + is a dirty tree, and that is the whole provenance problem:
# 86070d9 is the HEAD the capture was taken against, not the commit that
# carries the code that produced it. The work was committed afterwards and
# then AMENDED TWICE, so the commit that ships this image is 52843e0
# ("feat(shell): the edge inside the sampling window"). Only comments and
# the commit message changed across the amendments -- the code is identical
# -- but a reader tracing git=86070d9+ lands on the pre-commit HEAD and
# finds no tone_probe.cpp matching this output. Trace 52843e0 instead.
#
# WHAT IS NOT HERE. The source capture opens mid-block, ends mid-block, and
# carries two libDaisy "$$" overflow markers at its lines 3-4. Neither
# marker is in this excerpt: they sit outside the block, and the guard
# proves the parser's "$$" handling on constructed lines instead, where it
# can place the cut inside a value and on a token boundary and assert both.
#
# This file is READ-ONLY EVIDENCE. Nothing may be edited into it to make a
# test pass; if the parser and this block disagree, the parser is wrong or
# the firmware changed, and either way the answer is not here.
